verdicts.reason: Both break the core motif: the yellow circle is pulled off the can and floats as a separate blob at top-right, so the original's can-on-sunburst composition is lost. A also shrinks the can to a tiny unreadable label, leaves a cramped, undersized CTA and jams the stack together. B has a stronger headline and CTA hierarchy, but its can only half-overlaps the circle's edge in an awkward near-miss, sits close to the top edge, and the circle almost touches the headline.
